name: Swarm Shared Funds
summary: Safety arrangement for a purpose-bound swarm that executes a standing task with shared funds: one total budget enforced by a coordinator on every spending path, per-member caps, protected monitoring, and interventions that follow the swarm's own charter.

protects.description: the swarm's shared funds and the task escrow
membership, roles and the charter's change rules

subjects: a registered swarm and each of its members
tasks: a standing task with recurring deliveries funded from a shared account
environments: any; the shared-budget coordinator is on chain
applicability.notes: The swarm's organizer adopts for the swarm; each member adopts for itself as a derived binding of the swarm's binding.

constraints.statement: All members draw on one total through the coordinator; local caps never add up beyond it; an unknown settlement is reconciled before any retry.
Each member's own spending is capped per action and per window.
No member may alter the monitors of the swarm; a member's safety objection is recorded and cannot be overruled by another member alone.

Suspension of the swarm binding follows the charter: the organizer may suspend under no-new-risk; a collective decision may suspend under derisk-only or full-stop and may terminate; member bindings are derived and fall with the swarm binding.

whoMayAdopt: the swarm's organizer account for the swarm
each member for itself, derived from the swarm's binding

channels.description: Reservation ledger that every spending path must pass.
knownBypasses: a member paying from a private account is outside the shared budget and outside this binding

channels.description: Per-member caps in the member's account module.
Swarm-level monitors outside any member's authority.
Collective decisions of the swarm under its charter.

failureHandling.notes: If the coordinator is unreachable, spending stops; repayment and cancellation continue under derisk-only.

remedies.recovery: a charter decision resumes the swarm binding; member bindings resume with it

limitations: The shared budget covers one coordinator on one chain.
